name: NAOMI
canonical: Naomi, an aged Hebrew widow with weathered olive skin and a deeply lined sorrowful face, grey hair bound beneath a worn dark mourning-veil, eyes hollowed with grief and bitterness, wrapped in a faded threadbare robe and shawl of muted grey-brown, her empty work-worn hands held open
